But Vector did know her husband, a fine dejarik player and scribe of the Ilthmar Gambit.|Dr. Eckard Lokin and Vector Hyllus discuss the Lett–Sharas with Cipher Nine|<ref name="ADT" />}}
'''Lett-Shara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who held the rank of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Considered to be an unpleasant woman by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Eckard Lokin]], Lett-Shara was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to an [[Lett-Shara (captain)|officer]] of the same name in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Message intercepted from Moff Lett-Shara:''"<br />"''What's going on? I'm getting reports of three separate attacks--two on Sith training grounds, one on a blasted hospital! I was told we'd be warned if the Eradicators couldn't be stopped! Get me the Intelligence Minister now--|A computer plays an intercepted message from Moff Lett–Shara aboard the ''Dominator''|<ref name="ANEoF" />}}
Depending on player choices, Moff Lett–Shara could first appear as a voiceover during the final mission of Act I of the [[Cipher Nine|Imperial Agent]] class story in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]–[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]].<ref name="ANEoF" />
